description: src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 251-254: dialect is an open str; a name sqlglot does not know may make parse_one fail, and the classifier fails open to False so catalog results would be shown. Unreachable from the production caller today.

src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 565-576: components_to_markdown has no dialect parameter and always classifies under the all-engine union, while the module docstring calls it the same walker. No caller in src/.

src/sqllens/tools/_format.py lines 427-428 and 478-480: last_sql_is_introspection is a cached classifier value for last_sql kept correct only because two separate is_run_sql branches about 50 lines apart update the flag and last_sql; nothing ties them together, so a later edit could let them drift. Correct at this head.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 134-143: the fail-open parse failure logs only at DEBUG and the parsed-is-None branch logs nothing; with the default info log level, a catalog result shown because of a parse failure leaves no server-side trace.

tests/unit/test_format.py line 1936: comment says the controls below pass without a dialect and hold on pre-change code, but test_unparseable_sql_result_still_shown_with_dialect and test_chart_after_introspection_card_is_kept pass dialect=, which base components_to_blocks does not accept.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 110-128 and docs/internal/database-connectors/read-only-safety.md lines 67 and 73: text says a SHOW behind leading comments is introspection and fail-open applies 'apart from a SHOW', but first_sql_keyword does not skip comments, so a comment-led SHOW that fails to parse returns False. Demonstrated: '/* c */ SHOW 'abc' raises TokenError under every dialect. Routed to the self-contradicting-diff carve-out.

docs/internal/setup/config-loading.md line 33 (unchanged, stale at base): says show_details makes the factory unlock UI_FEATURE_SHOW_TOOL_ARGUMENTS for the default group only, but build_agent admits the default group whatever show_details is; this change relies on the card always being emitted. Same stale reasoning at docs/internal/agent/factory.md line 132.

src/sqllens/safety/readonly.py lines 23-25 and 110-113: one blank line instead of two between the module-level logger and class UnsafeSqlError, and the is_introspection_query docstring breaks mid-sentence. Not caught by configured ruff rules.
